assumptions: Finite simple undirected graphs; a hole is induced of length at least four, including C4.
A wheel is a chordless rim cycle plus one hub adjacent to specified rim vertices; only rim edges are subdivided.
Every sector has at least two edges, so the hub has no adjacent rim neighbors and the graph is triangle-free.
Peeling deletes vertices without fill; treewidth elimination adds a clique on remaining neighbors.
The tested implication is a proposed derived shortcut, not a claim attributed to the prior cycle or primary paper.
The general bisimplicial-vertex theorem is not proved here; no parent solution or novelty claim.
target: Test and retire the proposed shortcut from degree-two peeling to width-two tree decompositions within triangle-free even-hole-free graphs, using rim-subdivided wheels and independent fill-edge/minor/decomposition certificates. This is not a replacement for the incomplete parent fragment.
